To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stakeholders shape the translation of health research into action by continuously putting forth scenarios about future uses of the research.

stakeholders envision disparate futures for the translation of knowledge into policy action, that they mobilise elements of context that would affect the knowledge translation, and that they shape knowledge translation processes continuously by putting forth explicit or implied scenarios about the future.

stakeholders shape knowledge production and utilisation processes by continuously putting forward explicit and implicit scenarios about the desired future of the research results, and that mapping these scenarios may help in align to increase the likelihood that the research results may be used.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how stakeholders shape the translation of knowledge into policy and action.
the active role of actors in shaping translation processes and the importance of context for the use of health research results.
the role of stakeholders in shaping knowledge translation processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the scenarios of actors in the future are important to take into consideration when designing and conducting health policy research, in order to increase the likelihood of research results being utilised.
the study results show how stakeholders shape knowledge translation through the development of actor-scenarios.
the study shows that the stakeholders envisioned different futures for the tool, and that the stakeholders mobilized different elements of the context that would affect the use of the tool.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we need to be aware of the fact that stakeholders are not passive recipients of research results but that their engagement in research is not only a means of creating impact, but that it is also a means of shaping impact.
the translation of knowledge into policy action is a process that is shaped by the stakeholders that participate in the process.
the future is a social construction and that the role of stakeholders in shaping that future should be taken seriously.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the future of research results is not only shaped by researchers, but also by the actors who will use the results in practice.
stakeholders shape the translation of health policies by continuously putting forth implicit scenarios about future use.
stakeholders are active participants in the process of shaping knowledge translation.
